Logs are only generated locally on your device and are only written when you tap "Share Directly" or "Export Logs". Logs never contain video or audio and are never uploaded.\nWhen troubleshooting issues (such as internal audio capture denial): First turn on "Record Logs" (and "Verbose Logging" if details are needed) → reproduce the issue once → tap "Share Directly" to send logs. No background data is recorded when the switch is off.
